punchline: Same refusal, different sentence: 'I'm trying to quit' versus 'I'm not a smoker.'
thirty_sec: James Clear compares two people offered a cigarette. One says, "No thanks, I'm trying to quit." The other says, "No thanks, I'm not a smoker." The first still sees himself as a smoker fighting the urge. The second has changed who he thinks he is. Clear says every action is a vote for the person you want to become, and you don't need every vote, just a majority.
